title: Correspondence with Whitley Strieber on the UFO phenomenon
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Correspondence with Whitley Strieber on the UFO phenomenon, about unspecified (years before Sinister Forces volume) at unspecified (email), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and conversations I had with Whitley Strieber who had contacted me years earlier uh for something kind of unrelated.

plain: An author named Peter Levenda says that years ago a writer named Whitley Strieber got in touch with him by email, at first about something unrelated. Levenda tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that their later conversations about UFOs fed into his book series Sinister Forces. The point of telling it is that it shows how ideas about the phenomenon passed between people who write about it.
